writeAcknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement only. A subsequent GET must verify the exact target before frontend success. Optional data is not the persistence proof.

x-http.get_empty: success:true,data:null means no configuration. 404 means the endpoint is unavailable.
x-http.post: Create one configuration; return 201 and success:true. Do not create a duplicate singleton.
x-http.put: Replace the three configuration fields atomically; return 200 and success:true.
x-http.delete: Return 204 or 200 with success:true. GET must then return data:null. Card collection is not deleted.
x-http.normalization: Trim leading/trailing whitespace; reject control characters. title_accent may be an explicit empty string. Length is measured in Unicode code points.
x-http.provider_status: Frontend proposal; provider implementation and live persistence are not verified.
